answer: Locks are recorded in falcon, expire in forge, and spiral lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 184 aliases as a result needs 92 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 101 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
